At about 2½ miles Cliff was still leading our team and lying about 60th, Pete Bagnall was next, 83rd with Eddie Patterson 85th, next J. Masters 96th, Dave Baulch 118th, Charlie Walker 120th, Eric Gebbett about 150th, and Jack Brown about 160th.
The remaining strength lay in the excellent packing of Jack Brown, P. Newell and J.Masters who finished 7th, 8th and 9th making a total score of 28 points to Herne Hill's 30, and Hampstead 48.
We had only one runner in the mile, Steve Boreham, who did his fastest time in finishing 3rd. In the 1½ miles team race, J.
A rather unhappy looking 'Jumbo' Masters, whom we welcomed back after a long absence, hung on to our position but we had slipped back on times.
